data.narrative:
Parry Labs, a Series B defense and security company founded by John Parkes and Robert Miller, has raised $80M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 8 private peers in the same sector and stage, supplemented by 2 public defense-tech companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base value of $80M and applying a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $152M. Peer-median analysis across 8 same-sector, same-stage companies yields a median valuation of $1.1B, with the peer range spanning $300M to $3.0B. The median peer cohort includes Dream Security ($3.0B), Allen Control Systems ($2.2B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Twenty ($1.0B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a median of $638M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding Parry Labs' relative positioning within the defense-tech peer set. Key variables driving valuation within this range include revenue scale, customer concentration, and growth trajectory relative to the sampled cohort. The stage-progression method yields a conservative floor, while peer-median reflects sector-specific risk-adjusted multiples at comparable maturity stages.
